headline: Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
summary: Spotify removed over 50 million AI-generated or spam tracks from recommendations. The platform also updated its recommendation system. Goal is to highlight more music created by human artists.

headline: TikTok employees said they knew about child safety issues, but execs failed to act
summary: TikTok employees warned executives about child safety risks, court records reveal. Staffers were frustrated by management's failure to address concerns. Issues included minors bypassing age restrictions and appearing in explicit content.

headline: Adobe Lightroom mobile can now open closed eyes in photos with a simple tap
summary: Adobe Lightroom mobile now uses AI to open closed eyes in photos. A single tap activates the generative AI feature. Available on iOS, iPadOS, and Android versions of the app.

headline: Wii Sports is back on the Switch 2, and it rules
summary: Wii Sports, a Nintendo classic, returns on the Switch 2. It was Nintendo's best-selling software, rejuvenating the company. The game is hailed for its cultural impact and fun gameplay.

headline: Stupid Never Dies Blends a Wacky Tone with Aggressive Gameplay to Create a Unique Pop-Punk Action Game
summary: "Stupid Never Dies" is a new pop-punk action game. It combines a wacky tone with aggressive gameplay. The unique blend creates a distinct gaming experience.

headline: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Confirms a Popular Theory From the Game
summary: Netflix's Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 confirms a popular fan theory. The theory originates from the Cyberpunk 2077 game. Discussion centers around the concept of cyberpsychosis.

headline: Former Call of Duty Dev Says 'It's Hard to Watch' Xbox Make Money From Black Ops PlayStation Ports
summary: A former CoD designer believes developers should get royalties for ported games. He finds it tough seeing Xbox profit from Black Ops ports on PlayStation. The successful Black Ops 1 and 2 ports were recently released.

headline: Free $5 Reward Certificate for Signing Up for the New Best Buy Gamers Program
summary: Best Buy is offering a free $5 reward certificate. It's for new sign-ups to their Gamers program. Offer is available only while supplies last.

headline: Key Points from Covid Report on Care Homes: No 'Protective Ring' and Strict Visiting Rules
summary: The sixth Covid inquiry report details failures in care homes. Report highlights a shocking lack of PPE for staff. It also criticizes overly strict visiting restrictions.

headline: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra Broadcast Channels to Close
summary: BBC announces the closure of BBC Three, BBC Scotland, and Radio 4 Extra. These closures are part of a wider cost-saving initiative. The corporation aims to save £500m over two years.

headline: North Korea Publishes Photos of Kim Jong Un Amid Death Rumours
summary: North Korean state media released new photos of Kim Jong Un and his daughter. The release follows unsubstantiated rumors of the dictator's death. It attempts to quell persistent speculation about his health.

headline: Man Charged in Attack on Australian MP; Suspect's Father Claims Family Friendship
summary: A man has been charged following an attack on an Australian MP, Helen Haines. The suspect's father states Haines has been a family friend for over 20 years. MP Helen Haines remains in critical condition after the incident.
